# TildaZ v0.9.1

**Dead keys work on Linux.**

- Pressing `^` then `e` now gives `ê`, and the pending `^` is shown at the cursor while
  it waits for the next key. Until now a dead key produced nothing at all, so `^` could
  not be typed on French AZERTY, and German and Spanish layouts could not type a
  backtick. macOS and Windows were unaffected.
  ([#494](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/494), [#530](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/530))
